title: The rotated graph map of a 1-Lipschitz function is sqrt(2)-Lipschitz
statement: Let n, l be natural numbers, q a linear isometry of R^(n+l), and f : R^n -> R^l with |f(x) - f(z)| <= |x - z| for all x, z in R^n. Then the map Gamma : R^n -> R^(n+l), Gamma(x) = q(graphPoint x (f x)), is Lipschitz with constant sqrt 2: |Gamma(x) - Gamma(z)| <= sqrt(2) |x - z| for all x, z. In Lean the constant is NNReal.sqrt 2, i.e. LipschitzWith (NNReal.sqrt 2) Gamma.
lean_statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (q : Amb n ℓ ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] Amb n ℓ) (f : Rn n → Rn ℓ), (∀ x z, ‖f x - f z‖ ≤ ‖x - z‖) → LipschitzWith (NNReal.sqrt 2) (fun x => q (graphPoint x (f x)))
